Alright, let's try the backend with Gradle. It needs JDK 21. Ubuntu 22.04 → openjdk-21-jdk is available. Also, Gradle 9.7.1 is needed, and it supports up to Java 25, and the toolchain is auto-provisioned via foojay. The CI uses JDK 25. Locally, I'll go with installing openjdk-21.
